common.conflictTitle: Someone else saved this while you were editing
common.conflictBody: Your changes were not saved, so nothing of theirs was overwritten. Copy anything you need, then reload the latest version and apply your changes again.

launch.title: Launch center
launch.subtitle: Everything for launch day in one place: the checklist, what is live on the site and the dashboard, and the blog.

checklist.title: Launch checklist
checklist.allDone: Everything on the checklist is done.

live.title: Live now
live.empty: No banner or pop-up is live right now.

blog.title: Blog
blog.subtitle: Posts on the Atlas blog. Publishing needs both the English and the Arabic version.

empty.title: No posts yet
empty.description: Write the first post. It stays a draft until you publish it.

noResults.title: No posts match
noResults.description: Try another search or clear the filters.

editor.subtitle: Write both languages, check the preview, then publish now or schedule.

fields.title: Title
fields.excerptHint: One or two sentences shown on the blog list and in search results.
fields.bodyHint: Markdown. Use ## for sections; the title is the page heading.
fields.coverAltHint: Describe the image for people who cannot see it. Required when there is a cover image.
fields.seoTitleHint: Shown in search results and browser tabs. Leave empty to use the title.
fields.seoDescriptionHint: Leave empty to use the excerpt.
fields.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. The same for both languages.
fields.featuredHint: Shown first on the blog home page.

cover.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Stored as WebP.
cover.tooLarge: That file is larger than 5 MB.
cover.wrongType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
cover.failed: The image could not be uploaded.

related.hint: Up to three posts shown under this one.
related.max: Three related posts is the maximum.

validation.titleLength: Write a title of 3 to 140 characters.
validation.excerptLength: Write an excerpt of 20 to 300 characters.
validation.bodyTooLong: The body is longer than 60,000 characters.
validation.seoTitleLength: Keep the search title under 70 characters.
validation.seoDescriptionLength: Keep the search description under 170 characters.
validation.slug: Use 3 to 80 lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.
validation.authorName: Write an author name of 1 to 80 characters.
validation.oneLanguage: Write at least one language before saving.

publishCheck.title: Both languages are needed to publish

confirm.publishBody: It appears on the blog in English and Arabic straight away.
confirm.scheduleBody: It goes live at this time (your time zone). Until then, visitors cannot see it.
confirm.schedulePast: Choose a time in the future.
confirm.unpublishBody: It is removed from the blog and becomes a draft. Its address stops working until you publish it again.
confirm.archiveBody: It is removed from the blog and kept for reference. You can delete it later.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: How the post looks on the blog.
preview.noLanguage: This language is not written yet.

announcements.title: Banners & pop-ups
announcements.subtitle: Messages on the marketing site (a banner bar or a pop-up) and a banner on every dashboard.

surfaceHint.marketing_banner: A bar at the top of marketing pages. Up to two show at once.
surfaceHint.marketing_popup: A dialog on marketing pages. One shows at a time, the highest priority first.
surfaceHint.dashboard_banner: A banner at the top of the dashboard for signed-in users.

empty.title: No banners or pop-ups yet
empty.description: Create one for launch day. It stays off until you activate it.

noResults.title: Nothing matches
noResults.description: Try another search or clear the filters.

fields.name: Internal name
fields.title: Title
fields.ctaUrlHint: https://… or a site path such as /pricing.
fields.imageHint: Optional. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
fields.scheduleHint: Leave empty to show as soon as it is active, and until you turn it off. Times are in your time zone.
fields.pagesHint: Leave empty for every marketing page. A path also covers the pages under it and the Arabic version.

audience.all: Everyone signed in to the dashboard

validation.name: Write a name of 1 to 120 characters.
validation.oneLanguage: Write the message in at least one language.
validation.body: Write a message of up to 600 characters.
validation.title: A pop-up needs a title (up to 120 characters).
validation.ctaLabel: Keep the button label under 40 characters.
validation.ctaUrlRequired: Add the link the button opens.
validation.ctaUrl: Use an https:// address or a site path that starts with /.
validation.path: A path starts with / and has no spaces, query or #.
validation.endsBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

confirm.activateBody: It shows to visitors within a few minutes (inside its dates, if it has any).
confirm.deactivateBody: It stops showing and goes back to draft.
confirm.archiveBody: It stops showing and is kept with its results.

preview.label: Preview in {{language}}
preview.noContent: No {{language}} message: this language does not show it.

checklist.title: Launch checklist
checklist.subtitle: What has to be ready before launch. Tick items as they are done; the time and who ticked it are kept.

dialog.title: Title
dialog.linkUrlHint: Optional. A dashboard path such as /dashboard/platform/blog, or https://…
dialog.titleRequired: Write a title of 1 to 160 characters.
dialog.linkInvalid: Use https://… or a path that starts with /.

empty.title: The checklist is empty
empty.description: Add the things that must be ready before launch.

toasts.reorderFailed: The new order could not be saved.
